lines.speaker: Lord Elariel
lines.text: Renoux. Your family imports dye, I recall. Steady trade, if unglamorous.

lines.speaker: Valette
lines.text: Steady enough that I can afford to be curious about everyone else's business instead.

choices.text: Ask about the Lord Ruler's coming visit.
Ask which houses are hiring extra guards.

lines.speaker: Lord Elariel
lines.text: Unconfirmed, but Kredik Shaw has been quietly summoning household heads all week. Something has his attention.

lines.speaker: Lord Elariel
lines.text: Venture and Hasting both, from what my steward hears. Neither house is saying against whom.
